prompt: The McLafferty rearrangement produces an even-mass fragment via:

options.label: A concerted 6-membered transition state in which the γ-H migrates to the C=O oxygen while the α,β bond cleaves, giving an alkene + enol radical cation.

explanation: McLafferty: γ-H is transferred to the C=O oxygen through a 6-membered TS; the α-β C–C bond cleaves. The products are a neutral alkene + an enol-form radical cation. Diagnostic for aldehydes/ketones/esters with γ-H.
